keyPoints.en: A commercial export economy based on tin (Chinese mines, dredges from 1912) and rubber (seedlings 1877, H.N. Ridley).
keyPoints.bm: Ekonomi eksport komersial berasaskan bijih timah (lombong Cina, kapal korek mulai 1912) dan getah (anak benih 1877, H.N. Ridley).

keyPoints.en: Infrastructure: railway Taiping–Port Weld 1885, roads, Port Swettenham 1901.
keyPoints.bm: Infrastruktur: kereta api Taiping–Port Weld 1885, jalan raya, Pelabuhan Swettenham 1901.

keyPoints.en: Land titles; Malay Reservations Enactment 1913; immigrant labour (Chinese; Indians through the kangani system).
keyPoints.bm: Geran tanah; Enakmen Tanah Simpanan Melayu 1913; buruh imigran (Cina; India melalui sistem kangani).

keyPoints.en: Dual economy, uneven development (west vs east), dependence on tin and rubber exports.
keyPoints.bm: Ekonomi dualisme, pembangunan tidak seimbang (barat lawan timur), kebergantungan kepada eksport bijih timah dan getah.

keyPoints.en: Immigration created a plural society; communities were separated by jobs, areas and vernacular schools.
keyPoints.bm: Imigrasi mewujudkan masyarakat majmuk; kaum terpisah mengikut pekerjaan, kawasan dan sekolah vernakular.

keyPoints.en: New towns, MCKK (1905), SITC (1922) and health services (IMR 1900) grew, mostly on the west coast.
keyPoints.bm: Bandar baharu, MCKK (1905), SITC (1922) dan perkhidmatan kesihatan (IMR 1900) berkembang, kebanyakannya di pantai barat.
